environments.label: Spacecraft (transit)
environments.description: Weightless transit: gravity, radiation and isolation are emphasised; post-exercise heart-rate checks are on.

environments.label: Space station
environments.description: Orbital station: gravity, closed environment and isolation are emphasised.

environments.label: Rover / traverse
environments.description: Pressurised rover on a traverse: radiation and closed environment emphasised; glucose added to the daily check-in.

environments.label: Lunar base
environments.description: Surface habitat on the Moon: radiation, partial gravity and isolation emphasised.

environments.label: Mars base
environments.description: Mars surface: long communication delay, radiation, isolation and partial gravity; appetite added to the daily check-in.
